mapper.select: SELECT ba.*, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN speaker.type = 1 THEN speaker.user_id END) AS speakerUserId, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN requireUser.type = 2 THEN requireUser.user_id END) AS requireUserId, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN normal.type = 3 THEN normal.user_id END) AS normalUserId FROM biz_activity ba LEFT JOIN biz_activity_member speaker ON ba.id = speaker.activity_id AND speaker.type = 1 AND speaker.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN biz_activity_member requireUser ON ba.id = requireUser.activity_id AND requireUser.type = 2 AND requireUser.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN biz_activity_member normal ON ba.id = normal.activity_id AND normal.type = 3 AND normal.deleted = 0 ${ew.customSqlSegment}

SELECT ba.*, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN speaker.type = 1 THEN speaker.user_id END) AS speakerUserId, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN requireUser.type = 2 THEN requireUser.user_id END) AS requireUserId, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN normal.type = 3 THEN normal.user_id END) AS normalUserId FROM biz_activity ba LEFT JOIN biz_activity_member speaker ON ba.id = speaker.activity_id AND speaker.type = 1 AND speaker.status = 1 AND speaker.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN biz_activity_member requireUser ON ba.id = requireUser.activity_id AND requireUser.type = 2 AND requireUser.status = 1 AND requireUser.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN biz_activity_member normal ON ba.id = normal.activity_id AND normal.type = 3 AND normal.status = 1 AND normal.deleted = 0 WHERE ba.id = #{id} AND ba.deleted = 0 GROUP BY ba.id

SELECT ba.id, ba.title, ba.image, ba.start_time AS startTime, ba.end_time AS endTime, ba.create_time AS createTime, su.nickname AS createUser, ba.type FROM biz_activity ba LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON ba.create_user = su.id ${ew.customSqlSegment}

SELECT ba.id, ba.title, ba.image, ba.content, ba.start_time AS startTime, ba.end_time AS endTime, ba.create_time AS createTime, ba.type, ba.activity_people_nums AS eventPeopleNums, ba.attachment, member_data.speakerName, member_data.speakerId, member_data.requireUser, member_data.requireUserIds, member_data.normalUser, member_data.normalUserIds, COALESCE(member_data.enrolledCount, 0) AS enrolledCount FROM biz_activity ba LEFT JOIN ( SELECT am.activity_id,
MAX(CASE WHEN am.type = 1 THEN su.nickname END) AS speakerName, MAX(CASE WHEN am.type = 1 THEN su.id END) AS speakerId,
GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN am.type = 2 AND am.status = 1 THEN su.nickname END SEPARATOR ',') AS requireUser, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN am.type = 2 AND am.status = 1 THEN am.user_id END SEPARATOR ',') AS requireUserIds,
GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN am.type = 3 AND am.status = 1 THEN su.nickname END SEPARATOR ',') AS normalUser, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN am.type = 3 AND am.status = 1 THEN am.user_id END SEPARATOR ',') AS normalUserIds,
SUM(CASE WHEN am.type = 3 AND am.status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS enrolledCount FROM biz_activity_member am INNER JOIN sys_user su ON am.user_id = su.id WHERE am.deleted = 0 GROUP BY am.activity_id ) member_data ON ba.id = member_data.activity_id WHERE ba.id = #{activityId} AND ba.deleted = 0 AND ba.status = 2

SELECT ba.id, ba.title, ba.image, ba.start_time AS startTime, ba.end_time AS endTime, ba.create_time AS createTime, su.nickname AS createUser, ba.type FROM biz_activity ba INNER JOIN biz_activity_member bam ON ba.id = bam.activity_id LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON ba.create_user = su.id WHERE bam.user_id = #{userId} AND bam.status = 1 AND bam.deleted = 0 AND ba.deleted = 0 AND ba.status = 2 ORDER BY ba.create_time DESC LIMIT 5
